summary: Frontend + integration verification of the 4-part System-Bets / Bet-Builder / Share-Image / Feed-Rule batch on TipJar. Admin login worked. Submit-Tip modal detected the system bet from text (AI analyzed 'System 12 aus 14: Bayern-Leipzig … Dortmund-Mainz … PSG-Lyon …'), the data-testid='detected-system-badge' rendered 'System 12/14', a data-testid='leg-combo-odds-input-0' appeared on the multi-selection Bayern-Leipzig leg and accepted '1.55'. Publish (without 'live' timing) succeeded → POST /api/tips returned status=pending, bet_type=system, system_from=12, system_total=14, computed odds=2.52 (product of legs), legs[0].combo_odds=='1.55' persisted. Community/Members feed card renders data-testid='parlay-system-badge' with text 'System 12/14 · 3 Games' (NOT 'Parlay'). Share-image endpoint tested for lang=de and lang=el — both return 200 with distinct cached paths ('…de.webp' and '…el.webp'). Pregame feed rule holds: multi-leg system tip stays status='pending', is_live_post=None, timing=None (no auto live promotion). ALL review criteria satisfied.

task_2_community_feed_card.note_on_combo_pill: leg-combo-odds-<li> pill NOT rendered on card — by design. RateWall.jsx:1258 gates pill on `leg.combo_odds && selections>1 && !anySelOdds`. AI populated per-selection odds (Home Win@1.40) for our leg 0, so anySelOdds=true → pill correctly hidden. To empirically observe the pill on the card, a bet-builder leg with combo_odds set AND zero per-selection odds is required (e.g. raw text without 'Sieg 1.40'/'Über 1.5 1.30' odd tokens). Not a bug — matches spec: 'for a bet-builder leg with a combined odd AND NO per-selection odds'.

critical_code_review_comments: RateWall.jsx:1258 — leg-combo-odds-<li> pill gate `leg.combo_odds && selections.length>1 && !anySelOdds` is correct per spec. Consider adding a tiny hover-title on the pill explaining 'Combined odds set by tipster' for UX clarity (minor).
SubmitTipModal.jsx:315-318 — detected-system-badge renders correctly only when `detected.bet_type === 'system' && detected.system_total`. Good defensive check; no issues.
SubmitTipModal.jsx:393-405 — leg-combo-odds-input-<li> only renders when a leg has 2+ selections. This matches product intent (bet-builder). No issues.

SubmitTipModal.jsx:155 — publish body correctly sends bet_type/system_from/system_total; server persisted them and computed odds fallback (product of leg per-selection odds = 1.40*1.30*1.25 ≈ 2.275, but backend returned 2.52 — indicates the backend computed a different fallback path, possibly using combo_odds=1.55 for leg0 [1.55*1.30*1.25 = 2.52 ✓]. Combined-odds preference over selection product is working as designed).

AuthModal login mode uses data-testid='auth-username' for the 'USERNAME OR EMAIL' field — potential UX/testing pitfall: signup and login both share testid 'auth-username'. Consider distinct testids 'auth-login-identifier' vs 'auth-signup-username' to reduce ambiguity.
Community feed card badge text is 'System 12/14 · 3 Games' (in English while app is English). i18n key 'wall.system' + 'X/Y · N Games/Spiele' path is correctly localized — verified by test.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for review criteria (system badge, combo-odds input, wall system badge, pending status)

seed_data_creation: One test tip created id=29600edd-29c3-4fa2-892e-3b237c5d39ba (System 12/14 with 3 legs: Bayern-Leipzig, Dortmund-Mainz, PSG-Lyon; status=pending). Main agent may want to prune via admin delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 review tasks pass. The only nuance: leg-combo-odds-<li> pill on card intentionally hides when AI has per-selection odds (correct per spec). To empirically observe the pill on a card, seed a bet-builder tip where legs have combo_odds set AND all selections have empty sel_odds — e.g. raw text 'Match X - Y: over 2.5 and BTTS (kombiniert 1.75)' without per-selection odd tokens.
